meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

copy.tagline: 学习 UI 动效与细节打磨的设计哲学
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望提升软件界面的精致感和用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Learn design philosophy for UI animation and polish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the polish and user experience of your software interfaces.

howto.what: Claude 会像一位注重细节的设计工程师，帮你审查 UI 代码、优化动画和交互，让界面用起来更顺手。
howto.when: 当你询问 UI 设计、动画或代码审查相关问题时，Claude 会启用该技能。

say.text: 帮我审查这段按钮的 CSS 动画。
say.note: Claude 会按表格格式给出改进建议。

say.text: 这个下拉菜单的动画应该用什么缓动函数？
say.note: Claude 会基于动画决策框架给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a detail-oriented design engineer, helping you review UI code, optimize animations and interactions to make interfaces feel better.
howto.when_en: When you ask about UI design, animation, or code review, Claude activates this skill.

say_en.text: Review the CSS animation for this button.
say_en.note: Claude will provide suggestions in a table format.

say_en.text: What easing should I use for this dropdown?
say_en.note: Claude will answer based on the animation decision framework.
